usedFor: Aimfox runs LinkedIn outreach: “Add Profile To Campaign” enrolls a prospect and “Remove Profile from Campaign” stops messages.

bestTemplate.name: “Add Profile To Campaign” in Aimfox
bestTemplate.why: It enrolls someone in a campaign from just their profile link.

watchOut: “Add Profile To Campaign” needs the person's profile link, so check the link is filled in before it runs.
